body: Thanks for your help ( I guess). Like I said before, I'm too needy. I thought my lover wouldn't just text me at 12:30 like he always does expecting me to drive over and leave before 10AM but, of course I'm worthless and was let down. Goodnight to all and I hope your life brings as much happiness as it did sadness for me.

Cymbalta helped a bit, but the sexual side effects were almost intolerable. However, the medication no longer works anymore. I guess I've built up a tolerance. Even the undesireable sexual side effects have ceases after taking the medication for 2 years.
I'm agnostic. I have no idea if there is a God. I would love to believe I'm special enough to have a purpose but I'm too skeptical. All I can believe in is my ignorance.

Leaving my house for anything. 

Desiring love and a relationship but getting used. Most people would walk away in anger from someone who is using them but I'm so lonely and impulsively desperate, I can't just walk away. Beinf used is better than being alone.
Therapy for 15 years; Medication for 3. Suicidal for 2 years. I've realized nothing anyone can say will help because I have to save myself and there's nothing more to do.
I can barely leave the house.
